name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, directly boosting output quality without extra compute cost. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in inference time—about 8%—but the quality gain outweighs it for our use case.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it’s a scene-wide enhancer, not a face-focused tool. RealVisXL 4.0’s face-preserving upscaler locks us into Anthropic’s pipeline, but it’s the only model proven to maintain facial detail under EXCAVA’s current stress tests. Run a blind A/B test: feed identical inputs through both pipelines, measure face fidelity drop with a metric like FaceQNet—if RealVisXL 4.0 cuts the drop by 0.5% or more, it’s the call.
